name: Brain_Freeze
display_fullname: V Arachnos Cobalt Arachne Brain Freeze
display_help:
Wait, wasn't this Flashfreeze's signature move? Cobalt Arachne instantaenously freezes the targets brain by incasing their head in a block of ice, instantly putting them into a cryogenic stasis while inflicting superior cold and psionic damage. The foe's attack and movement speed is Slowed, due to the chills caused by the freezing blast.

Hell has just frozen over!
display_short_help: Ranged, Extreme DMG(Psionic/Cold), Foe Deep Sleep, -Recharge, -SPD
